sentences.text: Broadly speaking, the prosecution case is as follows.
sentences._hearing_file: Pankaj Mundotiya vs State Of Gnctd on 4 February, 2026.json

sentences.text: On 11.06.2024, a complaint of Sh. Anil Kumar Meena was received alleging that on being induced by one Ravi Singh through a college WhatsApp group he invested Rs.16,56,000/- by way of transfers from his bank account.
sentences._hearing_file: Pankaj Mundotiya vs State Of Gnctd on 4 February, 2026.json

sentences.text: The complaint was registered as FIR after preliminary enquiry.
sentences._hearing_file: Pankaj Mundotiya vs State Of Gnctd on 4 February, 2026.json

sentences.text: In the course of investigation, further details of cyber fraud and siphoning off of the proceeds of cheating across different layers came to be revealed.
sentences._hearing_file: Pankaj Mundotiya vs State Of Gnctd on 4 February, 2026.json

sentences.text: The present accused/applicant falls in one such layer of the beneficiaries of the proceeds of the alleged frauds.
sentences._hearing_file: Pankaj Mundotiya vs State Of Gnctd on 4 February, 2026.json

sentences.text: Further analysis of the bank account statement of the accused/applicant revealed that within a short span of 04 days from 06.05.2024 to 09.05.2024 more than Rs.13,00,000/- was credited into his bank account.
sentences._hearing_file: Pankaj Mundotiya vs State Of Gnctd on 4 February, 2026.json

sentences.text: The said credited amount was immediately debited through multiple transactions, reflecting suspicious financial activity and rapid layering of money.
sentences._hearing_file: Pankaj Mundotiya vs State Of Gnctd on 4 February, 2026.json

sentences.text: Further investigation revealed that against the bank account held by the company of the accused/applicant, 05 more online financial fraud complaints had been received and registered.
sentences._hearing_file: Pankaj Mundotiya vs State Of Gnctd on 4 February, 2026.json

sentences.text: One of those additional cyber fraud complaints pertains to Maharashtra and one each pertains to Gujarat and Karnataka.
sentences._hearing_file: Pankaj Mundotiya vs State Of Gnctd on 4 February, 2026.json

sentences.text: That would reflect the expanse of layering of the proceeds of crime.
sentences._hearing_file: Pankaj Mundotiya vs State Of Gnctd on 4 February, 2026.json

sentences.text: 5. Against the above backdrop, learned counsel for accused/applicant contends that the accused/applicant is, in fact, only a victim of the offence as he was not aware about the source of credit entries into his bank account.
sentences._hearing_file: Pankaj Mundotiya vs State Of Gnctd on 4 February, 2026.json

sentences.text: It is also contended that the allegedly cheated amount has been paid back by BAIL APPLN.

opennyai_summary.final__facts:
The applicant/accused seeks anticipatory bail in case FIR No. 60/2024 of Police Station Cyber Police, Dwarka for offence under Section 420/120B/34 IPC.
2.
A part of the proceeds of fraud was received by the accused/applicant in the bank Pankaj Mundotiya vs State Of Gnctd on 4 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/23482766/
1 account of his company.
opennyai_summary.arguments: It is also contended that in view of the nature and expanse of this crime, grant of anticipatory bail would not be appropriate as that would hamper investigation.
opennyai_summary.final__ANALYSIS:
7. In the backdrop of overall circumstances of this case, the anticipatory bail cannot be granted merely because the accused/applicant had paid back a sum of Rs.30,000/- to the complainant de facto as submitted by learned counsel for accused/applicant.
According to investigation so far carried, there is a vast expanse of layering of the cyber fraud involving enormous amount and a number of victims across different States of the country.
8. Looking into the overall nature of the crime described above, the need expressed by the investigating officer for custodial interrogation of the accused/applicant does not appear to be unjustified.
opennyai_summary.final__decision:
Not only this, vide order dated 22.12.2022, even the predecessor bench,
while extending the interim protection from arrest, had directed personal appearance of the accused/applicant in court on the next BAIL APPLN.
Considering the overall circumstances described above, I do not find it a fit case to grant anticipatory bail.
10. Therefore, the anticipatory bail application and the accompanying application are dismissed.
